decision_summary: Retrospective: v0.6.31 made calibration arithmetic executable while exposing that confidence semantics and cohort integrity remain separate governed problems.
rationale: Visionary: outcome accountability is now portable. Builder: a standalone package avoided destabilizing quality-gate records. Guardian: self-review caught a provenance-copy ambiguity and added resolution to the original outcome Evidence Origin; this materially improved the release before publication.
recommendation: Make v0.6.32 Calibration Cohort Integrity the next slice so aggregate statistics cannot conceal selection bias, dependence, missingness, drift, or high-risk subgroup failure.
target_audience: QIF maintainers and future release orchestrators
expected_user_reaction: The next work follows directly from the limitation exposed by this release rather than adding unrelated features.
